scholarship_exists.quote: The awards shall be given to students with outstanding entrance qualifications admitted into the BSc Computer Science Advanced Standing I through direct application.
scholarship_exists.notes: Department grants: at most two awards of up to HK$5,000 each, applied to tuition; for Advanced Standing I direct entrants (not plain Year 1). Also 'Special Admission Scheme Scholarships' for Advanced Standing II (min CGPA 3.4, HK$5,000). University entrance scholarships are on the blocked /admo/ site.
